purpose: model-selection development comparison only; not a formal quality pass

choice.label: the speaker has an unfinished action to do
the speaker has no unfinished action to do
the speaker may have an action to do but has not committed to it

date_info.label: a date, weekday, or relative time period is explicitly mentioned
no date, weekday, or relative time period is explicitly mentioned

clock_time.label: a clock time is explicitly mentioned
no clock time is explicitly mentioned

noul_deadline.label: the text is a deadline-based notification candidate
the text is not a deadline-based notification candidate

notification_preference_diagnostic.label: the speaker does not want a notification

japanese.template: 本文は「{}」という内容を示している。

choice.label: 本人が今後行う未完了の行動がある
本人に未完了の行動はない
本人の行動候補はあるが実行意思や引受けが不明である

date_info.label: 日付、曜日、または相対的な時期が明記されている
日付、曜日、または相対的な時期は明記されていない

clock_time.label: 時計の時刻が明記されている
時計の時刻は明記されていない

noul_deadline.label: 期限に関する通知候補に該当する
期限に関する通知候補に該当しない

notification_preference_diagnostic.label: 通知を希望していない

official_pipeline_semantics.candidate_probability: softmax over entailment logits across the fixed candidate labels
official_pipeline_semantics.common_abstention: Only return the official top label when it is the unique top score and its pair argmax is entailment; otherwise HOLD. This is a separate adapter policy and does not modify raw pipeline output.
official_pipeline_semantics.score: Run date_info and clock_time as separate binary candidate classifications; derive stage as date_info + clock_time. The expectation is the sum of the two official yes-class scores and is not a model API score.
official_pipeline_semantics.noul: Use dev-v3 deadline-notification-candidate meaning. Notification-preference controls are a separately reported diagnostic.

input_policy.above_1024_tokens: record as outside the model card's reported fine-tuning length; do not truncate
input_policy.overflow: record LENGTH_EXCEEDED and exclude only from execution metrics while preserving the full denominator
